gloss: frequency; number of times; alcohol content; lens prescription

definitions.explanation: The number of occurrences or repetitions of something. A count of how many times an event has happened.
The percentage of alcohol in a beverage. Commonly referred to as アルコール度数.
The strength of corrective lenses for glasses or contact lenses, measured in diopters.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree, time) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number, count). The word spans several domains, but the most common everyday uses are for alcohol content and eyeglass prescriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧{度数|どすう} — alcohol content/percentage
- {度数|どすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — high in content/frequency
- {度数|どすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — low in content/frequency
- ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度数|どすう} — glasses prescription strength
- {度数|どすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ — to increase the strength/frequency

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ — degree; a more general unit of measurement
- ⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧ — frequency; more commonly used for how often something occurs
- ⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧ — concentration; density (of a solution)
- ⟦{視力|しりょく}→視力：05033_shiryoku⟧ — eyesight; vision
